column1: maths|/mæθs/|学科|n. 数学|We learn maths and read books in the classroom.|我们在教室学数学、读书。
english|/ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/|学科|n. 英语|She reads an english story to the class each day.|她每天给全班读一个英语故事。
chemistry|/ˈkemɪstri/|学科|n. 化学|The students do a chemistry test in the lab.|学生在实验室做化学测试。
biology|/baɪˈɒlədʒi/|学科|n. 生物|We study biology and watch small animals in class.|我们学生物，课上观察小动物。
sport|/spɔːt/|爱好|n. 体育运动|He plays a sport with friends after school each day.|他每天放学后和朋友们做运动。
kite|/kaɪt/|爱好|n. 风筝|The child flies a red kite on the windy hill.|孩子在有风的山上放红风筝。
skate|/skeɪt/|爱好|v. 滑冰|We skate on the frozen lake after the winter snow.|冬雪后我们在冻湖上滑冰。
puzzle|/ˈpʌzl/|爱好|n. 拼图|She finishes a hard puzzle with her little sister.|她和妹妹完成一个难拼图。
food|/fuːd/|餐饮|n. 食物|We buy fresh food at the market near our school.|我们在学校附近市场买新鲜食物。
meal|/miːl/|餐饮|n. 一顿饭|The family eats a warm meal together at home.|一家人在家一起吃热饭。
bowl|/bəʊl/|餐饮|n. 碗|He puts rice in a blue bowl on the table.|他把米饭放进桌上蓝碗里。
plate|/pleɪt/|餐饮|n. 盘子|She puts the cake on a white plate after noon.|她中午后把蛋糕放白盘里。
careful|/ˈkeəfl/|品质|adj. 小心的|Be careful when you cross the busy street at noon.|中午过繁忙马路要小心。
gentle|/ˈdʒentl/|品质|adj. 温和的|The gentle teacher speaks to the shy child softly.|温和的老师轻声对害羞孩子说话。
humble|/ˈhʌmbl/|品质|adj. 谦逊的|The humble boy shares his toy with the new friend.|谦逊的男孩把玩具分给新朋友。
helpful|/ˈhelpfl/|品质|adj. 乐于助人的|The helpful girl carries the heavy bag for grandma.|乐于助人的女孩替奶奶拿重包。
daily|/ˈdeɪli/|频度|adv. 每天|We read a short story daily before we sleep.|我们每天睡前读短故事。
weekly|/ˈwiːkli/|频度|adv. 每周|We clean our classroom weekly with the whole team.|我们每周和全组打扫教室。
seldom|/ˈseldəm/|频度|adv. 很少|He seldom eats candy because he likes fruit.|他很少吃糖因为喜欢水果。
rarely|/ˈreəli/|频度|adv. 极少|She rarely watches TV and reads books instead.|她极少看电视，而是看书。
although|/ɔːlˈðəʊ/|逻辑连词|conj. 虽然|Although it rains, we still walk to the school.|虽然下雨，我们仍步行上学。
until|/ənˈtɪl/|逻辑连词|conj. 直到|We play outside until the sun goes down at dusk.|我们在外玩直到黄昏太阳落下。
before|/bɪˈfɔː(r)/|逻辑连词|conj. 在…之前|Wash your hands before you eat the warm meal.|吃热饭前要洗手。
after|/ˈɑːftə(r)/|逻辑连词|conj. 在…之后|We play football after we finish our homework.|写完作业后我们踢足球。
when|/wen/|逻辑连词|conj. 当…时|When the bell rings, the students go to class.|铃响时学生们去上课。
loud|/laʊd/|描述性形容词|adj. 大声的|The loud music makes the baby cry in the room.|大声音乐让屋里宝宝哭了。
ugly|/ˈʌɡli/|描述性形容词|adj. 丑陋的|The ugly duck becomes a white swan at last.|丑小鸭最后变成白天鹅。
rich|/rɪtʃ/|描述性形容词|adj. 富有的|The rich man gives food to the poor family.|富人给穷人家送食物。
silly|/ˈsɪli/|描述性形容词|adj. 傻的|The silly dog wears a red hat in the photo.|傻狗在照片里戴红帽子。
sweet|/swiːt/|描述性形容词|adj. 甜的|The sweet peach tastes nice on a hot day.|甜桃子在热天吃起来很棒。
